verdict.rationale: Firstbase markets done-for-you registered-agent and compliance services and a compliance dashboard, but nothing in the evidence shows an AI agent preparing or filing an annual report or compliance filing through the platform. There is no documented agent integration or API; probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec. The human-run 'registered agent' service is an adjacent, different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate an annual report or compliance filing to an agent that prepares it through the platform with minimal human input
